PINK CRES.は、合格者ゼロから始まった――三人の「difference」が大きくなるまで

PINK CRES. was formed in 2016 as Miyabi Natsuyaki's new group. But the first audition produced zero winners, and future members Hikaru Kobayashi and Yuka Nihei were both rejected once before returning. The group was named at Nippon Budokan, performed overseas before its first album, and saw a nationwide campaign halted by COVID-19 on the release day of its first major-distribution record. This essay follows that strange chronology through the way the three members' roles became more distinct.
